description: Settings of every run reported in the paper. reproduce.py reads this file; scripts/failrisk.py writes the settings of each run to <run>/config.json.

inputs.daily-B2: primary: 43 daily engineered features + log scans per day + active-day flag + 13 failure precursors = 58 features

data.reference_period: first 30 active days (>= 20 scans) of the tube's own log; every daily input is an offset from it
data.feature_scaling: median and 1.4826 MAD of the training tubes (floor 0.1 SD), clipped to +-5
data.labels: y7 = failure within 7 days, y30 = failure within 30 days; failure = last record of the tube's log

protocols.loo: leave one tube out: 19 folds; in every fold 3 of the 18 remaining tubes are validation tubes and 15 are training clients
protocols.loho: leave one hospital out: 3 folds (site map: tube -> hospital)
protocols.validation_tubes: drawn per fold and seed: numpy.random.default_rng(1000 * seed + index of the test tube(s) in the sorted tube list), see val_split in scripts/failrisk.py
protocols.weibull_prior: beta and eta fitted by maximum likelihood to the lives (scans) of the training and validation tubes of each fold

training.early_stopping: stop after 10 rounds without a relative improvement of the validation loss of at least 0.1 %; keep the round with the lowest validation loss
training.monotonicity_pairs: same tube, age gap > 0.02 eta, |log workload gap| < 0.3
training.final_model: ensemble selection over the grid members on the validation tubes (Caruana et al., 2004), then a causal moving average of the daily probabilities with a window of 1, 3, 7 (7 days) or 1, 3, 7, 14 days (30 days) chosen on the validation tubes

trend.health_index: relative filament current at identical (kV, mA, focus) settings, stable scans only, baseline from the first 50 scans of each setting, rolling median over 500 stable scans; HI = 1 - (1 - r) / D with D the median end-of-life decline of the training tubes
trend.shared_range: fine bins between the 1 % and 99 % quantiles of each client's counts
trend.rate: HI decrease per scan from a causal moving average (window 1 % of the log) and a lag of 0.5 % of the log

baselines.fedbn: batch-normalization layers local; the held-out tube re-estimates its statistics from its own earlier days (strictly causal)
baselines.cfl: one bipartition by cosine similarity of the client updates after 5 rounds; the held-out tube joins the cluster whose input centroid is nearest to the mean input of its earlier days

privacy.accounting: Renyi DP, integer orders, sampling rate 1, over the rounds actually run

evaluation.metrics: tube-weighted AUC (each tube weighted equally), Brier score
evaluation.confidence_intervals: AUC difference on all tubes; 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of a tube-level bootstrap
evaluation.robustness_subset: tubes whose log starts within the first 5 % of the life
